short_description: Safex 6 kg ABC stored-pressure extinguisher, ISI marked to IS 15683. 4A:55B rating, 25 s discharge, 6 m jet range, MS body.
long_description:
## What it is

The Safex 6 kg ABC Portable Stored Pressure extinguisher is the mainstream ISI-marked unit from Safex Fire Services, in production since the company was founded in 1972. It is a welded mild-steel cylinder, polyester powder coated inside and out, charged with 6 kg of MAP 40% mono ammonium phosphate powder tested to IS 4308; a MAP 90% charge is available on request. Charged weight is about 9.3 kg.

## What it's for

Safex lists it for homes and residential buildings, offices and commercial shops, industrial warehouses, and vehicles and transport hubs. Being an ABC unit it handles Class A, Class B, Class C and electrical fires from one cylinder, which is why it is the standard fit-out for factory floors and godowns where a single appliance has to cover mixed risk. At 6 kg it suits roughly 75 m² of protected area — a size up from the 4 kg unit typically used in homes.

## Key specifications

Rated 4A:55B, it works at 15 bar and is hydraulically tested at 35 bar. Discharge lasts about 25 seconds with a jet range of 6 m, which is a genuinely useful reach for warehouse aisles. It is ISI marked under BIS certification to IS 15683. Estimated envelope is roughly 160 mm across and 505 mm tall, so it fits a standard wall bracket or extinguisher cabinet.

## Application and installation notes

Site it per IS 2190: on the wall bracket, handle about 1 m above floor level, on an escape route and away from the hazard itself. Check the pressure gauge monthly and have the unit serviced every 12 months; hydraulic re-testing falls due every 3 years, and the cylinder must be refilled after any discharge. Safex designs the unit for easy refilling through its branch and distributor network, with the Secunderabad office covering Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. Powder residue is non-conductive but fine and needs vacuuming afterwards.

## What's in the box

One charged 6 kg extinguisher with hose and squeeze-grip valve, a wall bracket and the instruction manual, in a single corrugated carton.
